title: Scroll-Scrubbed Word Reveal
concept: Northcorrie Avalanche Bulletin, a fictional mountain forecasting office: today's danger headline sits on a pinned snow-white stage and sharpens word by word with native scroll (opacity, blur and lift from one normalized progress), with a live percent-read counter and danger badge, then an in-flow passage on buried surface hoar using the same reversible mapping and a snowpack profile below.
notes: Dependency-free: TreeWalker splits text nodes only, so em/mark/strong/link keep their semantics and wrapping stays free; one rAF maps scroll to --wp per word with ~22 % overlap. The stage opens at 36 % read so the first viewport shows the scrub. Reduced motion: no split, no pin, full text. Teardown restores the original subtrees.
